pedagogie.title: Pedagogy
pedagogie.text: Adapted education to develop every child’s potential.
pedagogie.headline: Adapted curriculum

paragraphs: The adapted curriculum at Rază de Soare Special School is built around each child’s real needs. Learning does not chase uniform academic performance standards, but progressive development of autonomy, communication and functional skills needed for community inclusion.
Every student has an individualized education plan, adapted to their developmental level, learning pace and cognitive and emotional profile.

blocks.heading: Core principles
list: Respect for each child’s own developmental pace

items.title: Cognitive development
items.text: Stimulating learning through activities adapted to each student’s level of understanding.

items.title: Communication and language
items.text: Developing functional communication — verbal or alternative — based on individual needs.

items.title: Personal autonomy
items.text: Building self-care skills and independence in daily activities.

items.title: Social skills
items.text: Practicing social interaction, shared living rules and appropriate community behaviors.

items.title: Practical life skills
items.text: Learning competences needed for more functional inclusion in family and social settings.

blocks.heading: Organization and structure
paragraphs: Classes have 6–8 students and are coordinated by two teachers, allowing personalized support and constant attention for every child.
Educational work is complemented by collaboration with specialists (counselor, speech therapist, physiotherapist), ensuring a multidisciplinary approach.

blocks.heading: Assessment and progress
paragraphs: Progress is assessed continuously by observing individual development and adapting educational goals.
The focus is on real progress, measured in concrete steps toward autonomy and inclusion.

consiliere.title: Counseling
consiliere.text: Emotional support and guidance for every child’s balanced development.
consiliere.headline: Counseling

paragraphs: The counseling service at Rază de Soare Special School offers psychological support adapted to children with special educational needs. The intervention supports emotional, behavioral and social development in a safe, structured setting.
Counseling is an integral part of the school’s multidisciplinary approach, helping balance the educational process with each child’s individual needs.

blocks.heading: Intervention goals
list: Increasing adaptation to the school environment

blocks.heading: Ways of intervening
paragraphs: Psychological support takes place through individual sessions, group activities and ongoing collaboration with teaching staff.
The counselor works closely with the family, offering recommendations and support so the intervention continues at home.

blocks.heading: Role in the multidisciplinary team
paragraphs: The counselor is part of the school’s multidisciplinary team, working with teachers, the speech therapist and the physiotherapist to ensure coherent support adapted to each child.

logopedie.title: Speech therapy
logopedie.text: Specialized support for language and communication development.
logopedie.headline: Speech therapy

paragraphs: Speech therapy at Rază de Soare Special School serves children with moderate, severe and profound intellectual disabilities, for whom language disorders are often linked to cognitive difficulties and global development.

The intervention is not limited to correcting isolated sounds, as often happens in mainstream education. It aims to build functional communication from the basics — receptive language, following simple instructions and stimulating the intent to communicate.

blocks.heading: Intervention context
paragraphs: A significant share of students have language delay linked to intellectual disability, and an important part are nonverbal. In these cases, speech therapy focuses on demutization and gradually building communication skills.

blocks.heading: Main directions of intervention
list: Stimulating receptive language and understanding of simple commands
Building compliance and the ability to follow instructions

blocks.heading: Methods used
paragraphs: Intervention includes alternative and augmentative communication (AAC) systems, pictograms, visual support, functional gestures and other tools adapted to each child’s level.
The goal is the most functional communication possible — verbal or alternative — so the child can express needs, preferences and emotions.

blocks.heading: The speech therapist’s role in the multidisciplinary team
paragraphs: The speech therapist collaborates constantly with teachers, the counselor and the physiotherapist to integrate communication goals into daily learning and keep the intervention coherent.

kinetoterapie.title: Physiotherapy
kinetoterapie.text: Adapted exercises for mobility and motor skills development.
kinetoterapie.headline: Physiotherapy

paragraphs: Physiotherapy at Rază de Soare Special School focuses on recovering and functionally developing motor skills of children with intellectual disabilities and associated disorders.
The intervention supports global coordination, balance and muscle tone, helping increase autonomy in daily activities.

blocks.heading: Intervention goals
list: Increasing muscle tone and physical endurance
Building motor skills needed for autonomy
Preventing motor regression and related complications

blocks.heading: Ways of intervening
paragraphs: Physiotherapy activities are adapted to each child’s developmental level and include structured exercises for coordination, mobility, balance and postural control.
Support may be individual or integrated into group activities, depending on goals set in the individualized education plan.

blocks.heading: Integration into educational activity
paragraphs: The physiotherapist works with teachers and other specialists to integrate motor goals into daily activities, helping transfer skills into real functional contexts.
Motor development is closely linked to personal autonomy, participation and the child’s inclusion in school and community life.
